subject: Scaling ML at Gravis
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Noticed you recently joined Gravis to lead the perception team & were hiring for a Senior ML Engineer, so it seems like fine-tuning your ML models could be top of mind for this year?

We work with leading robotics CTOs (including Pickle Robot, Carbon Robotics & Dexory) who were on a similar growth trajectory to Gravis, and were frustrated by slow model re-training hurting their ability to launch new ML products.

We built Encord to help AI teams remove data bottlenecks (focusing on data curation, annotation & active learning), so you can realise new revenue opportunities, faster.

Open to learning more?

subject: [YEAR] AI roadmap
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Congratulations on your recent appointment as CTO - I've been following Korro for some time & was curious to understand how you're thinking about AI model re-training to drive product improvements this year?

Given the behavioural complexities I imagine you're tracking across occupational therapy and healthcare settings, thought it could be relevant to introduce how Encord can help you capture this complexity in the training data (& improve vs. basic annotation tooling). 

Many of the CTOs / Heads of AI we work with were frustrated by the architectures of their existing annotation tooling (often CVAT or V7) limiting their ability to capture rich information from images / videos, as these labelling structures only support one level of depth.

We built Encord to support dynamic and nested labelling architecture of infinite depth, so you build richer, and more insightful models, faster. 

Open to learning more?

Happy New Year! I'm reaching out to see if you'd be open to a quick virtual
coffee in the coming weeks? We're very familiar with Drone Deploy, as we're
seeing a lot of momentum in your space (working w/ the likes of Skydio
etc.), so keen to trade notes & build a relationship. Not sure if your team
has any plans to reevaluate their data infra stack this year? Either way
it'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your feedback on what we're
building. I've included a short blurb of what we do below.

Encord is an SF-based data development platform (raised a $30M Series B
last year) built to help computer vision & multimodal AI teams get better
models to market, faster. 150+ of the world's top AI teams are leveraging
Encord to:

   - Easily curate, manage, visualise & search their unstructured training
   data at scale
   - Build active learning workflows to analyse both raw & labelled data,
   identifying model blindspots & find rare edge case
   - Automate parts of their annotation process - typically seeing 6-10x
   throughput gain

subject: [SENDER] / [NAME] - Quick Virtual Coffee
text:
Hi [NAME],

I'm sorry to bother you - I've made a presentation (see attached) for you
that details how we support many of the leading AI video surveillance
companies today - Flock Safety, LVT, Milestone Systems, Actuate etc.
Appreciate your busy, however if you can spare 15 minutes to have a quick
chat I'd be very grateful. Genetec's use case is our bread and butter - so
even just getting the opportunity to introduce myself & to get your candid
feedback as we look to scale from here (we just raised our Series B) would
be awesome! :)
